what_this_is_not: Not a result, not a retroactive declaration, and not itself a computation. It authorizes exactly one future run of make_hyp06_phase3_run.py, pinned to the exact code, lock, and real peer data that exist right now.
attestation_text: I authorize the one, single exploratory run of HYP-06's locked spec against the real returns of every one of its 25 locked peers around every one of its 778 locked anchor events. I understand this sample clears its own provisional 195-pair floor but that floor is itself provisional, not measured against HYP-06's own design, so this remains labeled exploratory, not confirmatory. I understand this cannot be undone or repeated, and that whatever the result, it will be reported as computed.
